mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals weakening real economic activity, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a collapse in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth (PAYEMS < 100k) signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to outperform a single-series model (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 620,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.6 million units, signals a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which depresses corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression model).
